children: Onconetix entered into a Grid Promissory Note with Realbotix, making available up to $5.0 million in unsecured loans, with $2.5 million funded at signing for general corporate and working capital needs. The note matures on Sep 11, 2027 and bears no interest unless the pending share exchange agreement is terminated, in which case interest accrues at 12% per annum. Realbotix Corp guarantees the obligations. If the share exchange closes, the note is automatically cancelled and Onconetix's Net Cash at Closing increases by $500,000 plus the outstanding principal.
: Unsecured grid promissory note with guaranty
: Support Realbotix working capital ahead of pending share exchange closing
